programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.sub-title: The Phoenix lights
programme.desc: On March 13th 1997, an extraordinary event occurred across the state of Arizona that has become the subject of great debate in the UFO community. Hundreds, and perhaps thousands of witnesses from all walks of life reported seeing a large v-shaped craft, over a mile across with unusual lights, travel slowly and silently by at a very low altitude. The Conspiracy Show travels to Phoenix to speak with key witnesses to the event who argue this craft was of extra-terrestrial origin. A noted skeptic in the UFO field is also engaged.

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.sub-title: The Conjuring House
programme.desc: On this episode the team investigate the RSS Discovery, RRS Discovery is a barque-rigged auxiliary steamship built in Dundee, Scotland for Antarctic research. Launched in 1901, she was the last traditional wooden three-masted ship to be built in the United Kingdom. Her first mission was the British National Antarctic Expedition, carrying Robert Falcon Scott and Ernest Shackleton on their first, and highly successful, journey to the Antarctic, known as the Discovery Expedition.
